doc.description: Green pixel avoider for front-camera experiments. It can draw a mask on the camera feed and optionally send body-velocity commands.

define.name: PLANT_AVOIDER_NAV_MODE_CONTROL
define.description: Allow body-velocity control while in NAV mode

define.name: PLANT_AVOIDER_SHOW_MASK
define.description: Draw a green mask over matched pixels

define.name: PLANT_AVOIDER_TURN_SPEED
define.description: Lateral body velocity used when turning (m/s)

define.name: PLANT_AVOIDER_STRAIGHT_SAFE_PCT
define.description: Go straight if center green load is below this percent

makefile.raw: nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_ROTATED_CAMERA_TOP_HALF=1 nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_Y_CENTER=46 nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_U_CENTER=106 nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_V_CENTER=129 nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_Y_TOL=20 nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_U_TOL=20 nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_V_TOL=20 nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_STRAIGHT_SAFE_PCT=25.0f nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_FORWARD_SPEED=0.18f nps.CXXFLAGS += -DPLANT_AVOIDER_TURN_SPEED=0.55f
